name: debonair-desktop
description: Use this computer as a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse through a Debonair adapter
author: Ryan Petris <ryan@petris.net>

scripts.build: vite build --config vite.main.config.mjs && vite build --config vite.preload.config.mjs && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:generated && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.simulate: npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path ../rust/Cargo.toml -p debonair-sim && DEBONAIR_SIMULATOR=../rust/target/debug/debonair-sim electron .
